newsitem.title: SWEDEN: New deals boost Gambro patients by 900.
newsitem.headline: New deals boost Gambro patients by 900.

text.p: Gambro Healthcare, a U.S. subsidiary of Swedish medical technology group Gambro, increased its number of dialysis patients by about 900 in March to 10,100, parent company Incentive said on Tuesday.
"Through this expansion Gambro Healthcare strengthens its position as a leading dialysis care company on the U.S. market," the company said.

From April Gambro Healthcare will own and operate a clinic for chronic and acute dialysis treatment at the John Hopkins Hospital in Baltimore, Maryland, Incentive said. The clinic currently has about 160 patients.

Gambro Healthcare also increased its holding in its joint venture with Community Limited Care Dialysis Centers to hold a majority, it said without giving further details. The venture operates five dialysis clinics in Cincinnati, Ohio.
The group has also become responsible for medical competence at a dialysis clinic in Brooklyn, New York, which is currently treating about 250 patients, Incentive said.
Furthermore, Gambro Healthcare opened a new clinic in Crossville, Tennessee.
"With these clinics, Gambro Healthcare owns 109 dialysis clinics, which provide care to about 10,100 patients," Incentive said.

"The expansion is also an important step in the explicit strategy of Gambro Group to strengthen its position, through acquisitions and growth, as a global leader in products and care for renal patients."
